# Data organization

## Background 

Some variables of interest (e.g. BMI, preterm birth, etc.) need to be derived from existing data. In this script, we derive those variables and add them to the meta data file, creating a final meta data file. 

## Packages

```{r Packages}

#"tidyverse" for data organization
#install.packages("tiderverse")
library(tidyverse)


#"here" for easy locating of files
#install.packages("here")
library(here)

```

## Loading in meta data file

```{r Loading in meta data file}

Meta_data_1 <- read.csv(here("SVN_Microbiome_meta-data_curated.csv"))

```


## Deriving variables

```{r calculating maternal BMI}

#Calculating BMI of each mother
Meta_data_1 <- Meta_data_1 %>%
  mutate(cmtom = Maternal_height/100) %>% 
  mutate(hightsquare = cmtom*cmtom) %>%
  mutate(BMI = Maternal_weight/hightsquare) %>% 
  select(-c(cmtom, hightsquare))

```

```{r transforming units}

#Calculating B12 pmol
#molar mass of B12: 1355.4g/mole
#moles = grams x 1 mole/molar mass
Meta_data_1 <- Meta_data_1 %>%
  mutate(Vitamin_B12_pmol.mL = Vitamin_B12_pg.mL/1355.4) %>% 
  mutate(Vitamin_B12_pmol.L = Vitamin_B12_pmol.mL*1000) %>% 
  select(-c(Vitamin_B12_pmol.mL))

#Calculating RBP4 umol/L
#molar mass of RBP4: 31 kD = 31000g/mole
#moles = grams x 1 mole/molar mass
Meta_data_1 <- Meta_data_1 %>%
  mutate(RBP4_umol.L = RBP4_ng.ml/31000)
  

#Calculating Folate nmol/L
#molar mass of folate: 441.4 g/mol
#moles = grams x 1 mole/molar mass
Meta_data_1$Folate_ng.mL <- as.numeric(Meta_data_1$Folate_ng.mL)

Meta_data_1 <- Meta_data_1 %>%
  mutate(Folate_nmol.mL = Folate_ng.mL/441.4) %>% 
  mutate(Folate_nmol.L = Folate_nmol.mL*1000) %>% 
  select(-c(Folate_nmol.mL))

```

```{r Contineous to categorical}
#Continuous to categorical data  ----
Meta_data_1 <- Meta_data_1 %>%
  mutate(BMI_cat = cut(
    BMI,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 18.5, 24.99999, 25.0, 30.0, Inf),
    labels = c("Underweight", "Healthy Weight", "na",  "Overweight", "Obese"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Maternal_age_cat = cut(
    Maternal_age, 
    breaks = c(-Inf, 18, 35, Inf),
    labels = c("<18", "18-35", ">35"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(Maternal_education_cat = cut(
    Maternal_education,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 5, 10.1, Inf),
    labels = c("No Education", "1-5", "6-10",">10"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Parity_cat = cut(
    Parity, 
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0.99999, 2, Inf),
    labels = c("0", "1-2", ">2"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(GA_birth_cat = cut(
    GA_birth,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 34, 37, Inf),
    labels = c("<34", "34-37", ">=37"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(GA_birth_binary = cut(
    GA_birth,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 37, Inf),
    labels = c("NA", "Preterm", "Term"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(Birth_weight_cat = cut(
    Birth_weight,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 2500, Inf),
    labels = c("Low Birth Weight", "Normal Weight"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(inflammation_CRP_cat = cut(
    CRP_mg.L,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 8, Inf),
    labels = c("Normal CRP", "Elevated CRP"),
    include.lowest = FALSE,
    right = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(inflammation_AGP_cat = cut(
    Alpha1_AGP_ng.ml,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1000000, Inf),
    labels = c("Normal AGP", "Elevated AGP"),
    include.lowest = FALSE,
    right = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(inflammation = if_else(Alpha1_AGP_ng.ml>1000000 | CRP_mg.L>8, "Inflammation", "No Inflammation")) %>% 
  mutate(inflammation_AGP_cat = cut(
    Alpha1_AGP_ng.ml,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1000000, Inf),
    labels = c("Normal AGP", "Elevated AGP"),
    include.lowest = FALSE,
    right = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(Anemia_Binary = if_else(Hb<11, "Anemia", "No_Anemia")) %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA = case_when(
  GA_birth < 22 & Birth_weight < 481 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth < 22 & Birth_weight >= 481 & Birth_weight <= 578 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth < 22 & Birth_weight > 578 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 22 & Birth_weight < 481 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 22 & Birth_weight >= 481 & Birth_weight <= 578 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 22 & Birth_weight > 578 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 23 & Birth_weight < 538 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 23 & Birth_weight >= 538 & Birth_weight <= 658 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 23 & Birth_weight > 658 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 24 & Birth_weight < 602 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 24 & Birth_weight >= 602 & Birth_weight <= 751 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 24 & Birth_weight > 751 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 25 & Birth_weight < 674 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 25 & Birth_weight >= 674 & Birth_weight <= 858 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 25 & Birth_weight > 858 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 26 & Birth_weight < 757 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 26 & Birth_weight >= 757 & Birth_weight <= 980 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 26 & Birth_weight > 980 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 27 & Birth_weight < 849 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 27 & Birth_weight >= 849 & Birth_weight <= 1119 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 27 & Birth_weight > 1119 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 28 & Birth_weight < 951 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 28 & Birth_weight >= 951 & Birth_weight <= 1276~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 28 & Birth_weight > 1276 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 29 & Birth_weight < 1065 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 29 & Birth_weight >= 1065 & Birth_weight <= 1452 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 29 & Birth_weight > 1452 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 30 & Birth_weight < 1190 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 30 & Birth_weight >= 1190 & Birth_weight <= 1647 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 30 & Birth_weight > 1647 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 31 & Birth_weight < 1326 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 31 & Birth_weight >= 1326 & Birth_weight <= 1860 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 31 & Birth_weight > 1860 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 32 & Birth_weight < 1473 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 32 & Birth_weight >= 1473 & Birth_weight <= 2089 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 32 & Birth_weight > 2089 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 33 & Birth_weight < 1630 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 33 & Birth_weight >= 1630 & Birth_weight <= 2332 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 33 & Birth_weight > 2332 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 34 & Birth_weight < 1795 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 34 & Birth_weight >= 1795 & Birth_weight <= 2583 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 34 & Birth_weight > 2583 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 35 & Birth_weight < 1967 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 35 & Birth_weight >= 1967 & Birth_weight <= 2838 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 35 & Birth_weight > 2838 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 36 & Birth_weight < 2144 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 36 & Birth_weight >= 2144 & Birth_weight <= 3089 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 36 & Birth_weight > 3089 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 37 & Birth_weight < 2321 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 37 & Birth_weight >= 2321 & Birth_weight <= 3326 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 37 & Birth_weight > 3326 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 38 & Birth_weight < 2495 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 38 & Birth_weight >= 2495 & Birth_weight <= 3541 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 38 & Birth_weight > 3541 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 39 & Birth_weight < 2663 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 39 & Birth_weight >= 2663 & Birth_weight <= 3722 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 39 & Birth_weight > 3722 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth == 40 & Birth_weight < 2818 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth == 40 & Birth_weight >= 2818 & Birth_weight <= 3858 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth == 40 & Birth_weight > 3858 ~ 'LGA',
  GA_birth > 40 & Birth_weight < 2818 ~ 'SGA',
  GA_birth > 40 & Birth_weight >= 2818 & Birth_weight <= 3858 ~ 'normal',
  GA_birth > 40 & Birth_weight > 3858 ~ 'LGA' )) %>% 
  mutate(SVN = ifelse(GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | Percential_weight.GA == "SGA", "SVN", "Normal")) %>% 
  mutate(miscarriage = ifelse(Birth_outcome == "1", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(MTP = ifelse(Birth_outcome == "2", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(Stillbirth = ifelse(Birth_outcome == "3", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(Born_Alive = ifelse(Birth_outcome == "4" | Birth_outcome == "5", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(Infant_death = ifelse(Birth_outcome == "4", 1, 0))

#to ensure that these are considered as factors and not as numerical values
Meta_data_1$miscarriage <- as.factor(Meta_data_1$miscarriage)
Meta_data_1$MTP <- as.factor(Meta_data_1$MTP)
Meta_data_1$Stillbirth <- as.factor(Meta_data_1$Stillbirth)
Meta_data_1$Born_Alive <- as.factor(Meta_data_1$Born_Alive)
Meta_data_1$Infant_death <- as.factor(Meta_data_1$Infant_death)



```

```{r Tac}
#Transforming Tac data from PCR cycle thresholds to positive/negative 
Meta_data_1 <- Meta_data_1 %>%
  mutate(EPEC_eae_cat = cut(
    EPEC_eae,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 35, Inf),
    labels = c("Not Available", "Positive", "Negative"),
    include.lowest = FALSE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(EPEC_cat = cut(
    EPEC,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 35, Inf),
    labels = c("Not Available", "Positive", "Negative"),
    include.lowest = FALSE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(STEC_cat = cut(
    STEC,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 35, Inf),
    labels = c("Not Available", "Positive", "Negative"),
    include.lowest = FALSE,
    right = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(PhHV_amplification_failure = ifelse(PhHV == 40 | PhHV_2 == 40, "Failure", "No Failure")) %>% 
  mutate(MS2_amplification_failure = ifelse(MS2 == 40 | MS2_2 == 40, "Failure", "No Failure")) %>% 
  mutate(aEPEC_cat = ifelse(EPEC_eae_cat == "Positive" & STEC_cat == "Negative" & EPEC_cat == "Negative", "Positive", "Negative")) %>% 
  mutate(tEPEC_cat = ifelse(EPEC_eae_cat == "Positive" & STEC_cat == "Positive" & EPEC_cat == "Negative", "Positive", "Negative"))



```


## Saving file
```{r Saving file}
#saving table as a new csv
write.csv(Meta_data_1, here("SVN_Microbiome_meta-data_curated_full.csv"))


```
